instruction_summary: Fit a small parametric model to how the paper's causal-inner-product geometry quantities (causal off-diagonal, Euclid/causal ratio R, subspace survival) move across Study 001's 2023-2025 five-model era ladder, and write down an updated, per-era statement of the linear-representation / causal-inner-product claim. No new inference; a fit over 001's saved numbers.

steps.description: Read 001's per-model metrics and aggregate (5 models: metrics_*.json + aggregate.json)

Fit single-covariate OLS (year, log-params) + per-era means for causal off-diagonal and ratio R, with leave-one-out and bootstrap uncertainty; family paired deltas; subspace survival; R>1 test; covariate confound correlations
Render the fit figure (causal off-diagonal & R vs era, 5 points + per-era means + OLS trend + LOO band, family markers)

key_results.causal_offdiag_range_across_ladder: 0.052-0.062 (intersection); flat with era: slope +0.0010/yr, R2=0.055, LOO slope range [-0.0042,+0.0028] (sign flips)
key_results.R_ratio_range_all_models: 1.22-1.49 (intersection); R>1 on all 5 models and all concept sets
key_results.R_trend_with_year: slope -0.091/yr, R2=0.38, LOO slopes all negative; bootstrap 95% CI [-0.25,+0.03] includes 0
key_results.family_split: R high for LLaMA lineage (1.42, 1.48), low for Qwen/OLMo (1.22-1.30); OLMo-3 (open, 2025) sits with Qwen not with era
key_results.family_stability: R varies ~4.8x more across families (same era) than within a family generation step (mean within |dR|=0.056 vs cross-2024 |dR|=0.271)
key_results.subspace_survival: 21/22 (Llama-2) and 26/26 (each 2024-2025 model); mean ~99% of viable concepts vs paper's 26/27
key_results.exception_set: thing=>part only, Llama-2-only (d=0.85); rises to d=1.17-1.36 on all newer models
key_results.appendix_D2_test: Contradicted in direction: causal advantage is LARGEST on LLaMA (Euclid furthest), SMALLEST on newer Qwen/OLMo (Euclid nearly as good); Euclidean does not fail on newer models
key_results.updated_claim: Across 2023-2025 base models (7-8B), the causal inner product keeps causally-separable concepts approximately orthogonal (mean off-diagonal |ip| ~ 0.052-0.060, flat across generations) and remains R = 1.22-1.48x more orthogonal than the Euclidean inner product on every model; subspace linearity holds for ~99% of viable single-token concepts (26/26 on the four 2024-2025 models, 21/22 on Llama-2), the sole exception thing=>part confined to Llama-2. The advantage's size is governed by family/tokenizer (LLaMA ~1.4-1.5, Qwen/OLMo ~1.2-1.3), not scale or year (R vs log-params corr ~ -0.09); the apparent era-decline of R is the changing family mix. Contra Appendix D.2, Euclidean does not degrade on newer models -- it draws closer to causal.
key_results.fit_status: Every fit has negative leave-one-out R2 and a bootstrap slope CI spanning 0: descriptive only, not a scaling law (5 points).

comparison_to_original.followup: flat 0.052-0.062 across ladder (intersection); no era trend (slope +0.0010/yr, R2=0.06)
comparison_to_original.note: Concepts stay approximately orthogonal at every generation; scale/era does not measurably move it
R>1 everywhere; the decline is a Llama->Qwen/OLMo family split, not a scale effect
Claim still representative and strengthens; exception thing=>part is Llama-2-only

comparison_to_original.quantity: Appendix D.2 (Euclidean works on LLaMA-2, fails on newer)
comparison_to_original.followup: Contradicted: causal advantage largest on LLaMA, smallest on newer Qwen/OLMo
comparison_to_original.note: Euclidean draws closer to causal on newer non-LLaMA models rather than failing

deviations: 5 data points: all fits are descriptive (every leave-one-out R2 is negative; every bootstrap slope CI includes 0). No scaling law is claimed.

Era is confounded with family (2023=Llama-only, 2025=Qwen/OLMo-only) and with tokenizer coverage (coverage vs year corr +0.80; causal vs vocab +0.89). The 22-concept intersection series is used to neutralize coverage; year/scale slopes are not read as scale effects.
Primary fit series is the 22-concept intersection (coverage-controlled); own-viable and all-27 sets are also reported. Params are published/nominal totals (approximate).
No model or era dropped; all 5 of 001's models used. No new model inference.
